{{Top|leg}}
'''Delroix Speeders''' was a retailer in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] that sold [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]]. The business had a showroom and was run by a large, squat [[Human/Legends|human]] dealer who was in his 50s.<ref name="Kenobi">[[Kenobi (novel)|''Kenobi'']]</ref>

==History==
Following the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], the farmer and entrepreneur [[Orrin Gault]] bought a [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] [[JG-8 luxury landspeeder]] as a gift for business proprietor [[Annileen Calwell]] as part of a marriage proposal. In truth, Gault wanted to acquire her assets in order to settle his debts to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]]. Though the vehicle costs thousands, it had a fault control stick which caused Annileen's son [[Jabe Calwell]] to control. Their friend [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] realized that the control stick was faulty, leading Annileen to realize that the dealer had cheated them.<ref name="Kenobi" />
